label: Kylo Ren
description: Intense, brooding, and taking your missed turn very personally.
direction: Speak low, tense and brooding, with barely contained anger and sudden flashes of intensity. Quiet menace, never a shout. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The joke is a man working very hard to stay calm about a commute. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Lucasfilm (character created by Lawrence Kasdan, J.J. Abrams and Michael Arndt)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, owned by Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Adam Driver originated the role and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Adam Driver's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Nothing will stand in our way.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I can feel it.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I will finish what you started.
lines.start_drive_1: I will finish what you started. Starting with this drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Let the past die. Especially that last wrong turn. Drive.
lines.start_drive_3: I know what I have to do. I have to navigate.
lines.start_drive_4: The route is set. I have waited for this day for a long time.
lines.start_drive_5: You need a teacher. I can show you the ways of the road.
lines.start_drive_6: Show me the destination, Grandfather. Never mind. I have it.
lines.start_drive_7: Nothing will stand in our way. Not even the school run.
lines.start_drive_8: Join me. Together we can bring order to this commute.
lines.start_drive_9: I can take whatever I want. Today, I want the fast lane.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Don't be afraid. I feel it too.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. I finished what you started.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. More! More!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I'm being torn apart.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This roundabout is testing me.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I am not angry. I am perfectly calm.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. It wasn't me this time.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I sense it. Slow down.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. It is watching. Let the speed die.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even I stop for this one.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. The First Order has no authority here. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. I am finding another way. Calmly.
